items.title: Make validation timeout failures diagnose timeout configuration clearly
items.context: runValidationCommand currently marks timedOut and executeValidationPlan renders only "(timed out)". Add explicit guidance that the command was killed by timeout and that validate.commands[].timeoutMs may need adjustment; do not hide real test failures.
items.userSees: When a validate command times out, terminal output includes a line like `✗ timeout: node -e ... (timed out after 100ms)` plus `Timeout diagnostic: command was killed by the configured timeout; increase lattice.config.json validate.commands[].timeoutMs if the command is legitimately long-running`.

happy.desc: A timed-out validation command remains a failed validation and prints the timeout duration plus timeoutMs recovery guidance.

edge.desc: A non-timeout failing validation command does not print timeout-specific recovery guidance.

adversarial.desc: Timeout diagnostic text does not change allPass/status or mark required timeout failures as optional warnings.

items.title: Make stale verification evidence recovery explain hash-binding drift
items.context: renderEvidenceStaleHint already appears in session_brief/story_advance/validate hints, but it uses legacy koala command wording and does not state that stale means HEAD/material hash binding changed rather than proof that test logic failed.
items.userSees: When stale verification evidence is detected, terminal output says `EVIDENCE STALE ... hash binding changed` and shows `lattice verification_evidence_refresh_stale --storyId=B-56ce` followed by `lattice validate --story=B-56ce --json`.

happy.desc: The shared stale evidence hint prints lattice recovery commands and explains HEAD/material hash binding drift.

edge.desc: The hint still renders nothing when no stale evidence entries exist.

adversarial.desc: The wording does not imply stale evidence means the original verification command logically failed.

items.title: Improve owner lease recovery guidance for same-worktree context switches
items.context: Owner lease gate and session_brief already enforce active/stale ownership. Add same-worktree detection/guidance so context compaction in the same story worktree gets safer instructions before using forceTakeover; preserve fail-closed behavior.
items.userSees: When an active owner lease belongs to another session but the recorded owner cwd matches the current worktree, terminal output says this appears to be the same worktree after a session/context switch and instructs the operator to verify no other live session is writing before using `--forceTakeover`.

happy.desc: session_brief renders same-worktree context-switch guidance when the owner cwd and current cwd match but session id differs.

edge.desc: Different-cwd active foreign owner leases keep the existing read-only/wait/forceTakeover guidance.

adversarial.desc: Same-worktree guidance does not transfer or refresh the owner lease without explicit takeover intent.

items.title: Clarify delivery-check fallback without forging reviewer authority
items.context: DONE gate correctly requires signed delivery-check.json. When delivery reviewer tooling is unavailable, hints should state the compliant fallback boundary: delivery_check_set must still be executed as the delivery reviewer actor/provenance, not by the main agent pretending to review itself.
items.userSees: When DONE is blocked by missing delivery-check.json, terminal output says to rerun koala-review-delivery or use `delivery_check_set` only with `agentId=koala-review-delivery` / reviewer provenance; it explicitly states the main agent must not self-sign the delivery check.

happy.desc: DONE oracle missing-delivery-check hint names delivery_check_set plus the koala-review-delivery provenance requirement.

edge.desc: Existing delivery-check hash mismatch and unverified docsPromise paths keep their current recovery hints.

adversarial.desc: Fallback wording does not authorize main-agent self-review or weaken delivery-check DONE blocking.

items.title: Add unsupported codex core-command namespace suggestions
items.context: The CLI supports lattice codex verify/doctor but lattice codex session_brief and lattice codex aux_doc_list fail with unhelpful suggestions. Add unknown-command guidance or aliases to route core commands to ordinary lattice equivalents without changing gate semantics.
